title.zh: 修订第1613号共和国法关于 Iloilo 省公共工程项目的若干规定的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Iloilo
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Iloilo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3295_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Priority No. 23, page 43-B and Priorities Nos. 30 and 33, page 44, group III, for the Province of Iloilo, Appendix B, Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"23. Janiuay (Elementary) Tolarucan Completion ₱3,000.00 "30. Janiuay Poblacion Repair 4,000.00 "3. Leon (High School) Poblacion Repair 6,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
